name: jinko
description: Skills for quantitative systems pharmacology using Jinkō platform. Support the full modeling workflow: gathering evidence and observed data, building and calibrating models, estimating uncertainty, running sensitivity analyses, creating virtual populations, simulating clinical  trials, visualizing results, and producing analysis.
